title: Bone Tea
description: At the start of the next combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] your starting hand.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks a counter that decrements after each combat where the effect triggers. Effect applies after the first turn of the next 1 combat, then disables itself. Upgrades all cards in your starting hand when triggered.
